empty.title: No data connected yet
empty.description: Upload files, connect Google Sheets, or link a database from a project to start the cleaning pipeline.

common.rowsColumns: {rows, plural, one {# row} two {# rows} other {# rows}} · {columns, plural, one {# column} two {# columns} other {# columns}}

source.title: Source connection
source.description: Tables detected from the data you connected to this project.

profile.title: Data profiling
profile.statisticalProfileComputed: Statistical profile of {table}, computed by the profiler agent.

discover.title: Schema discovery
discover.idleDescription: Scan all tables and infer foreign-key/primary-key relationships.
discover.scanningLabel: Scanning tables and scoring candidate relationships…
discover.scanningStage: This can take a moment if ambiguous keys need AI escalation.
discover.runPrompt: Run schema discovery to detect relationships between your tables.
discover.resultDescription: DAAS has scanned all tables and scored candidate relationships.
discover.relationCount: {count, plural, one {# relation} two {# relations} other {# relations}}
discover.noCandidates: No candidate relationships found — this is expected for a single-table project.
discover.manualReviewBody: {count, plural, one {# relationship} two {# relationships} other {# relationships}} scored below confident thresholds and need manual mapping before they can be used.

relationships.title: Relationship review
relationships.needDiscoveryDescription: Run schema discovery first to see candidate relationships.
relationships.description: Detected relationships between tables. Approve or reject each, or add one yourself if the automatic scan missed it.

form.title: Add a relationship manually
form.description: Know two tables are related but the automatic scan missed it? Define it here — it's added as approved immediately, and you can still reject or remove it below.
form.sameColumnWarning: A column can't be related to itself.
form.duplicateWarning: This relationship is already in the list below.
form.manualReasoning: Added manually — not scored by the automatic scan.

diagram.title: Schema diagram
diagram.description: Drag tables to rearrange. Click a connection to approve or reject it — it stays in sync with the list below.

relationships.noneFound: No candidate relationships were found automatically. Add one manually above if you know two tables are related, or continue without any if this project's tables are truly independent.

clean.title: Cleaning plan
clean.generateDescription: Generate an AI cleaning plan for {table}.
clean.generatingLabel: Profiling and generating a cleaning plan…
clean.editDescription: AI-generated cleaning plan for {table}. Edit it below before executing, if needed.
clean.planSubtitle: Remove any step you don't want, or add your own — the AI will give its opinion on anything you add.
clean.noStepsYet: No steps in this plan yet.
clean.addStepPlaceholder: e.g. Cap outliers in `order_value` at the 99th percentile
clean.opinionLoading: Getting the AI's opinion on this step…
clean.alreadyCleanBody: The AI reviewed {table} and found no missing values, duplicates, placeholder values, or type mismatches — no cleaning steps were generated. You can still add one manually below, or just execute to confirm and move on.
clean.notRunYet: Not run yet. Only the primary table has been cleaned so far.

validate.title: Validation
validate.description: Referential integrity, primary-key uniqueness, dtype consistency, and duplicate-row checks before saving.
validate.notReadyBody: Clean the primary table and the remaining tables (see the Clean stage) before running integrity validation.
validate.blockedBody: One or more relationships have orphaned foreign keys that a real constraint would reject, or a primary key has duplicates/nulls. Resolve these before saving.

reconcile.title: Reconciliation
reconcile.description: Before/after orphan-rate checks for every approved cross-table relationship.
reconcile.noChecks: No reconciliation checks to show — this project has no cross-table relationships to reconcile (or "Clean remaining tables" hasn't been run yet from the Clean stage).

save.title: Save to project
save.description: Trusted, reconciled data is committed to the project's Postgres schema. Once saved, downstream agents can begin work.
save.schemaHolds: Schema {schema} now holds {count, plural, one {# table} two {# tables} other {# tables}}.
save.runValidateFirst: Run the Validate stage and pass integrity checks before saving.

errors.planFailed: Could not generate the cleaning plan
errors.editPlanFailed: Could not save your plan edits
errors.cleanRemainingFailed: Could not clean the remaining tables
errors.opinionFailed: Could not get the AI's opinion on that step
errors.saveFailed: Could not save to the project
